staging._comment: Copy to scripts/style-ab-targets.local.json (gitignored). base: an https staging origin (first label 'staging' or ending in '-staging', no port, no IP; production hosts are refused) or a loopback http origin. models: the allow-list of FREE model ids; a run also checks that GET /v1/models lists each as free and available. The gateway must run with HOUSE_STYLE=auto or on.
